verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs show it can accept online one-time card payments. Its quick-start routes include payment links (Smartlink), a payment button, e-commerce plugins and a JS library, and there is a test-data-to-production path. Nothing in the evidence shows self-serve sign-up or how long it takes to go from signing up to a live first payment, which is the core time element of this story. Missing for 10: evidence of self-serve account sign-up and activation, any documented time-to-live or approval timeline, and hands-on or independent confirmation that a first payment can be taken within a day.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up
